bluetooth.notes: Official Quick Start Guide shows Android Fast Pair popup 'JBL Wave Buds 2', Windows Swift Pair 'New JBL Wave Buds 2 found', and instructs to choose 'JBL Wave Buds 2' in Bluetooth settings. Pattern must NOT be loosened to '^JBL Wave Buds' alone, since the original Wave Buds (2023) advertise 'JBL Wave Buds' and look almost identical. Also distinct from 'JBL Wave Beam 2' / 'JBL Wave Flex 2'. BLE advertisements may additionally carry a Fast Pair service (UUID 0xFE2C) but the model ID is not published. JBL is owned by HARMAN (a Samsung subsidiary); manufacturer company ID not verified, left null. Manual-pairing gesture wording in pairingSteps is interpreted from the QSG pictograms (text-light guide) and should be confirmed on a real unit.

pairingSteps: Put both earbuds in the charging case to charge, then take them out; they power on and enter pairing mode automatically on first use.
Android 6+ with Google Fast Pair: keep the earbuds near the unlocked phone and tap 'Connect' on the 'JBL Wave Buds 2' popup.
Otherwise open Settings > Bluetooth on the phone and choose 'JBL Wave Buds 2'.

To pair another phone (multi-point, max 2 connected): with the earbuds out of the case, tap once then touch and hold the earbud touch surface for 5 seconds (per the QSG 'Multi-point connection' diagram) until they enter pairing mode, then select 'JBL Wave Buds 2' on the new device.

If pairing fails: forget 'JBL Wave Buds 2' on the phone, factory-reset the earbuds as shown in the QSG 'Factory reset' diagram (touch-gesture sequence on the earbuds; exact order of 'tap x2' and 'hold 5 s' is only shown graphically), then pair again.
